title: Gentle Dreams & Shiraz
identity: Dave Heath’s Gentle Dreams and Shiraz originated as pieces for other instruments and were arranged by Gerard McChrystal for soprano saxophone and piano. Stainer & Bell identifies Camden Music CM115; another catalog lists 18 pages. These are paired contrasting pieces rooted in jazz.

evidence.claim: Publisher explains that McChrystal arranged the pair for soprano saxophone and piano after their earlier use on a flute CD.
Edition listing identifies two pieces, 18 pages, and jazz roots.
Exam practice listing includes Gentle Dreams for tenor saxophone at Grade 5, but it is a separate tenor adaptation/teaching route.

collection_flag: Adapted works rather than original saxophone compositions. Soprano sax edition is by Gerard McChrystal; a separate tenor-sax exam listing indicates educational use but does not determine soprano edition level.
gaps: No score preview or soprano performance recording verified.
Exam Grade 5 listing is for tenor saxophone and may reflect that syllabus arrangement only.
